description: Aires于1960年推出的旁轴相机。配备Aires Q Coral 1:2.8 f=4.5cm, Coated, front-cell focusing。快门速度Seikosha SLV leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.。使用24 x 36 mm on 35mm film。

specs.镜头: Aires Q Coral 1:2.8 f=4.5cm, Coated, front-cell focusing
specs.尺寸: M43 x 0.75Manual states Filter size M49 but measurement on actual camera was M43
specs.快门: Seikosha SLV leafshutter. Speeds 1 to 1/500 sec. and B.
specs.闪光灯: Socket on left side. X and M synchronisation
specs.英文简介: The Aires M28 is a 35mm rangefinder camera made by the Japanese company Aires c1960, page 43.
